entries.reason: -[PHAsset playbackStyle] is the port's own answer for an asset - an image, a video, or Unsupported when the library cannot say - so a filter of style Image is the image filter and a filter of style Video is the video filter; the other four cases of the enum name what this release keeps no record of, an animated image, a live photo and a looping video being of iOS 9.1 and later
entries.effect: PHAssetPlaybackStyleImage gives +imagesFilter and PHAssetPlaybackStyleVideo gives +videosFilter, so the picker shows images or movies; Unsupported, ImageAnimated, LivePhoto and VideoLooping give the filter that names no media type
